UnitedHealth does not report a single "cost of revenue" line, so I defined it as medical costs plus cost of products sold. Q4 2024 is the full-year 2024 figure minus the nine months ended September 30, 2024.

- Medical costs: 264,185 − 197,150 = 67,035 (USD millions)
- Cost of products sold: 46,694 − 34,230 = 12,464 (USD millions)
- Cost of revenue, Q4 2024: 67,035 + 12,464 = 79,499 (USD millions), or about $79.5 billion

If cost of revenue were instead read as total operating costs, the Q4 figure would be 367,991 − 274,957 = 93,034 (USD millions). I used the narrower definition.
